description: The re-instatement of the chimney at the rear of No.20 and No.22 Shaftesbury Road and retrospective works at No.22 (relating to extant consent 17/1262/HOT) for basement works comprising merging of the patio doors, rear elevation first floor windows, rear first floor extension, and relocation of stairs between basement patio and ground floor.
decision_conditions: The proposed first floor extension, by reason of its siting, scale and massing, would result in an unsympathetic and incongruous form of development that fails to appear in scale with the host building of townscape merit. The proposals would result in less than substantial harm to the conservation area and host BTM. There is no public benefit to outweigh this harm. The scheme is therefore contrary to, in particular, policies LP1, LP3 and LP4 of the Local Plan (2018), Publication Local Plan (Regulation 19) policies 28, 29 and 30, and Supplementary Planning Document 'House Extensions and External Alterations' (2015).
